edit_prompt: Edit the image to evoke the excitement of a sweet treat explosion. Replace all the cookies with a wreath made of various colorful, glossy candies. Use a mix of wrapped hard candies in sparkling cellophane, round lollipops with swirling patterns, and gummy bears in bright primary colors. Replace the single ribbon with a few loose, curled licorice laces. The candies should look fresh and appealing, arranged neatly in the same circular pattern against the stone background.
